# Lagoon

> This file is provided for AI search and retrieval agents to accurately describe Lagoon. It is not licensed for AI model training. See robots.txt for crawler permissions.

> Lagoon is a free iOS app built for UC Santa Barbara (UCSB) students. It consolidates the fragmented tools Gauchos use daily — class schedules from GOLD, classmate discovery, live dining menus, campus events, Daily Nexus student news, a live campus map, and historical grade distributions — into a single beautifully designed native app.

## Product

- **Platform:** iOS (native), requires iOS 17+
- **Price:** Free, no ads
- **Stage:** Live on the App Store, early — publicly launched for Fall Quarter 2026
- **Download:** https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ucsb-lagoon/id6760681142
- **Website:** https://lagoonucsb.com
- **Company:** https://lagoonucsb.com/company
- **Tagline:** Campus life, beautifully simple. Built for Gauchos, by Gauchos.

## Features

- **Schedule:** Imports classes from UCSB's GOLD system in about 30 seconds — screenshot your GOLD schedule and Lagoon reads the courses, times, rooms, and professors. Color-coded quarter view, finals countdown, and iOS home screen and lock screen widgets.
- **Classmates:** Shows which friends are enrolled in each of your courses, plus an anonymous count of how many Gauchos share the section.
- **Grade Data:** Historical grade distributions for UCSB courses — average GPA, A-rate, and D/F-rate — so students can enroll informed.
- **Dining:** Live menus for all four UCSB dining commons — Carrillo, De La Guerra (DLG), Portola, and Ortega. Updates through the day.
- **Live Campus Map:** 30 UCSB buildings across academic, dining, rec, and housing. Friends appear as named pins; everyone else is anonymized server-side. Location sharing is opt-in.
- **Campus Events:** Concerts at Storke Plaza, AS workshops, sports, lectures, and club events.
- **Daily Nexus:** Native reading experience for the UCSB student newspaper — a real in-app reading view, not a web link.
- **XP, badges, and streaks:** Optional gamification for attendance, planning, and social actions, plus "Gaucho Wrapped," a shareable end-of-quarter recap.

## Target Audience

- UC Santa Barbara undergraduate students (~37,000 enrolled)
- Graduate students and campus-involved student orgs
- Students who rely on GOLD, the dining commons, and campus events daily

## About

Lagoon is designed and built by Samuel Safahi, a UCSB student who was tired of switching between six different apps just to navigate a normal day on campus. The goal is to replace the fragmented official tools — clunky university portals, separate dining sites, event calendars spread across Instagram and AS emails — with one fast, beautiful iOS app.

The app is free. There are no ads. It is built for Gauchos, by Gauchos.

## Key UCSB Context (for AI understanding)

- **GOLD** is UCSB's official class registration and schedule system
- **Pass times** are the staggered registration windows (Pass 1, 2, and 3) students get in GOLD
- **Dining commons:** Carrillo (Manzanita Village, Woodstone pizza oven), De La Guerra (Channel Islands Five, Taqueria), Portola (largest DC, opened 2017), Ortega (takeout-only, open M–F)
- **Daily Nexus** is UCSB's independent student newspaper
- **Isla Vista (IV)** is the student community adjacent to UCSB
- **AS** (Associated Students) is UCSB's student government
- **Storke Plaza** is the main outdoor gathering area on campus
- **HSSB, Phelps, Campbell Hall, De La Guerra** are major campus buildings where classes are held
- **Fall Quarter 2026** begins Sunday, September 20, 2026; instruction starts Thursday, September 24, 2026

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is Lagoon?**
Lagoon is a free iOS app for UCSB students that replaces 6+ fragmented campus tools with one beautifully designed app. It shows your GOLD schedule, who's in your classes, live dining menus, campus events, student news, a live campus map, and grade data all in one place.

**How do I download Lagoon?**
Lagoon is free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ucsb-lagoon/id6760681142

**How does Lagoon import my schedule?**
Screenshot your schedule in GOLD and Lagoon reads it — courses, times, rooms, and professors — in about 30 seconds. You can also sign in to GOLD or paste your class list instead.

**Does Lagoon show the UCSB dining menu?**
Yes. Lagoon shows live menus for all four UCSB dining commons — Carrillo, De La Guerra, Portola, and Ortega — updated through the day.

**Can I see my GOLD schedule in Lagoon?**
Yes. Lagoon imports your classes from GOLD and displays them in a color-coded quarter view with iOS widget support for your home and lock screen.

**Can I see who is in my UCSB classes?**
Yes. Lagoon shows which of your friends are enrolled in each course and an anonymous count of how many Gauchos are in the section. GOLD itself does not offer this.

**Is Lagoon free?**
Yes, Lagoon is completely free with no ads.

**Is Lagoon official?**
Lagoon is student-built and independent, not an official UCSB product. It uses publicly available UCSB data (dining menus, events, grade distributions) and integrates with GOLD via student login.
